sections.heading: Weldoperator
sections.content:
The Weld operator welds vertices of particle shape meshes.

Threshold: the maximum distance threshold between vertices in order for them to be welded together.Open edges only: only vertices on open edges (edges connected to a single face) will be welded.

Threshold: the maximum distance threshold between vertices in order for them to be welded together.
